QuestInfo.name: Pork Delivery 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1091003##k has one last mission for you. No WAY it's pig-related this time!
QuestInfo.1: Serryl wants you to hunt #r#o1210104#s#k, get 20 cuts of Pork, and bring them back to her. Hooray for Pirates!
QuestInfo.2: You brought 20 cuts of Pork to Serryl.

0.0: We'll be eating good for weeks thanks to you! So, you ready for your next mission?

yes.0: Great! Now, I bet you saw some pigs with pretty blue ribbons wrapped around them, right? Those pigs live on #bBlue Ribbon Beach#k, and they're the tastiest pigs you ever ate!
yes.1: Hunt them down and bring me #r20 pieces of Pork#k so we can have a real feast!

no.0: Why not? It'll be fun this time! Really!

1.0: You got the Pork? Good. This'll fill the crew right up!
1.1: This is the stuff, all right. I can tell #r#o1210104##k meat apart from any other pork, easy.

yes.0: You got me the Pork, but I can't just give it to the crew without any seasoning, right? Pirates are all about the seasoning!

item.0: Come on! It'll take at least 20 cuts of Pork to feed the crew.
